title: Maximum Product Subarray
summary: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.

tests.explain: The subarray [2, 3] has product 6. Including -2 flips the sign and 4 cannot fix it.
The zero splits the array. The best is the single value 0, since -2 and -1 are not adjacent.
Two negatives multiply to a positive: -2 * 3 * -4 = 24.

hints: Unlike sums, a product can flip sign: a very negative running product becomes very positive when multiplied by another negative number. So the smallest product so far matters as well as the largest.
For each position keep two values for subarrays ending there: the maximum product and the minimum product.

At each x, the new max is max(x, max * x, min * x) and the new min is min(x, max * x, min * x), computed from the old values. Track the best max seen over the whole pass. A zero resets both values naturally because of the lone x option.
